plugins.name: change-management
plugins.description: Organisational change management practice in one install — setup interview, change definition, stakeholder and impact analysis, change risks and health check, strategy and measurement plan, sponsor, engagement, champion network, communications (draft-never-send), training needs, readiness and go/no-go, resistance, go-live support, change saturation heatmap, adoption, reinforcement, BAU handover, lessons learned and status reporting. Five personas, one owned skill library, one shared change record under docs/change/. People change only — not IT change control.
